create_table: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS marcas_empleados (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, idsucursal INTEGER, idempleado INTEGER, idtipo INTEGER, fecha DATE, entrada TEXT, salida TEXT)

pull.sql: SELECT id,idsucursal,idempleado,idtipo,fecha,entrada,salida FROM empleado_marcas WHERE idsucursal = %s AND id > %s AND id <= @@last_id and year(fecha) = year(curdate()) ORDER BY id
pull.lookup: JOIN sync_ids b ON b.id_servidor = ? AND b.tabla = 'empleado_marcas' JOIN sync_ids c ON c.id_servidor = a.idempleado and c.tabla = 'empleados' JOIN sync_ids d ON d.id_servidor = a.idtipo and d.tabla = 'tipo_marcas_empleados'

update.set: SET a.idempleado = ?, a.idtipo = ?, a.fecha = ?, a.entrada = ?, a.salida = ?

queue.sql: SELECT id, idsucursal, idempleado, idtipo,fecha,entrada,salida FROM empleado_marcas WHERE idsucursal = %s

push.join: JOIN marcas_empleados b ON b.id = a.idregistro LEFT JOIN sync_ids c ON c.id_local = b.id and c.tabla = 'marcas_empleados' JOIN sync_ids d ON d.id_local = b.idempleado and d.tabla = 'empleados' JOIN sync_ids e ON e.id_local = b.idtipo and e.tabla = 'tipo_marcas_empleados'
